name: U-Splitter
summary: U-Splitters are belt-routing components added in Demo V8. Use split routes when you need to inspect or distribute a production line rather than send everything down one path.
version: Demo V8 announcement (September 11, 2026); follow your installed build’s prompts

data.community: Players propose separate scanner branches when the original scanning line backs up. Follow both outputs through scanning, then join them afterward if needed.
data.check: Watch one product enter each branch and reach its destination. The V8 note does not specify balancing ratios or guaranteed throughput gains.
